question_text: Explain one reason a portable measuring device may use an OS configured only for its required hardware and tasks.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The OS can omit unused services, reducing memory and processing overhead. This leaves limited resources available for measurement/control tasks, helping the device meet its performance needs.

marking_points.criterion: Links to limited device resources/task performance.
